title: sm120-nulltest: pre-registered ceiling-ledger study of MelBandRoformer inference on the NVIDIA RTX 5090 (SM120) — code and evidence
description: Harness, pre-registration (prereg_amendments.md), session scripts, analysis tools, ledger and result generators, and the pod evidence bundle (node-level Nsight Systems traces, unprofiled timings, matched-pair blocks, graph verification, ideal-cost models) for a pre-registered study of launch-side tooling (CUDA Graphs, torch.compile reduce-overhead) on a band-split audio separation model on consumer Blackwell. Audio clips are not included. See README.md and docs/release/zenodo_subset.md for what the deposit contains and why.
